## Exact conditional distinction

Let A1,A2 be compatible coherent kernels on the declared complete endpoint basis, with initial |x> and final |y>. Field/source/port labels are retained wherever future operations can access them. On a finite path family, set b_z=(A2)_{yz}(A1)_{zx}. Without a record, p_coh(y|x)=|sum_z b_z|^2. Splitting the same update into factors whose product is unchanged, or inserting a coherence-preserving pause, cannot by itself change this probability. More actual applications are a different experiment, not a universal decoherence mechanism.

Explicitly record the intermediate label by |z,ready> -> |z,D_z>, and do not coherently reuse the record before the final material readout. Orthogonal D_z gives p_commit(y|x)=sum_z |b_z|^2 by the inherited complete-label path-pair observer. The physical difference is record coupling plus restricted observation, not software deletion. For a coarse record c(z), p_coarse(y|x)=sum_m |sum_{z:c(z)=m}b_z|^2: interference within indistinguishable record groups remains. The full-label case is a sufficient illustrative model, not a claim that position observation measures every internal/field freedom.

With rank-one complete projectors P_z in a fixed basis, D(X)=sum_z P_z X P_z. For diagonal rho_n=sum_x p_n(x)|x><x| and a unitary coherent update A_n, rho_(n+1)=D(A_n rho_n A_n^dagger) gives p_(n+1)(y)=sum_x |(A_n)_{yx}|^2 p_n(x). Thus this fully monitored model has additive classical path probabilities between commits. Degenerate projectors instead retain intra-block quantum dynamics. Subsequent unmonitored operations can create new coherence, but identical reduced input states alone cannot reconstruct an unknown former relative phase. No hypothesis that all evolution stops is needed.

## Record-string kernel

For the inherited Gamma_y(gamma,delta)=<v_gamma(y),v_delta(y)>, a factorizable nondemolition record coupling adds normalized D_gamma and gives Gamma'_y=Gamma_y entrywise-multiplied by G, where G(gamma,delta)=<D_gamma,D_delta>. This is PSD because it is the Gram matrix of v_gamma tensor D_gamma. Its diagonal is unchanged; only the overlaps of complete record strings govern the changed cross terms.

If N fresh initially independent record units conditionally leave a product record, G_N=product_k g_k with g_k=<D_(k,gamma),D_(k,delta)>. This factorization is NOT valid for an arbitrary reused/correlated apparatus; then retain the joint record Gram kernel. Identical |g_k|=r<1 suppresses that pair's coherence magnitude by r^N. Finite N with all factors nonzero does not yield exact zero. One orthogonal record already eliminates that pair's reduced cross term; sustained observation is not necessary. |g_k|=1 does not attenuate visibility, though phase changes can shift a fringe. Identical records do not even supply that phase difference.

Hence the workable interpretation of losing forward computation is losing coherent continuation ACROSS recorded alternatives/cuts, not losing every kind of dynamics or all interference. Internal relation-extension index k is not automatically physical time or heartbeat index n. Literal advance computation of not-yet-realized physical future remains a stronger, unestablished hypothesis. If every ordinary heartbeat performed full dephasing, unobserved cross-heartbeat coherence would also be lost; ordinary coherent updates and selective forced commits cannot silently be identified.

## Distinguishing predictions and missing mechanism

Keep the same preparation and total nominal coherent update; compare an added coherence-preserving schedule boundary, a path-distinguishing recorded commit, the same interaction coherently undone before recombination, and coarse monitoring identical on both paths. Conditional prediction: only distinguishable record sectors lose their original mutual interference; genuine reversible undo restores it; intra-block interference survives coarse monitoring. These are symbolic consequences, not executed experiments.

A theory predicting extra suppression from tick count alone, from path-insensitive identical records, or irreversible loss after a complete coherent undo needs an additional state variable and quantitative trigger/update law. That supplies content beyond a relabelling of a measurement/decoherence channel. The mechanism observation -> physical heartbeat generation, its rate, work source and detector-dependent basis have not been derived. Zeno inhibition of transitions is not equivalent to the loss of all within-subspace quantum dynamics. Terminal screen readout does not retroactively remove an interference position distribution simply because the screen is repeatedly read.
